adversarial_case_ref: 04-golden-set-and-adversarial-plan.md adversarial case 6: 'Evidence is restricted and only a sanitized projection is permitted'
added_2026_08_26: This fixture did NOT ship with the original bundle. A cross-family adversarial review (Kimi K3) found that case 6 was named in the case list, acknowledged as needing to stay schematic, and then simply not delivered -- leaving the ONE category where a missing negative control is most expensive (the PII/sanitization boundary) with no fixture at all. Contains no real restricted content of any kind: every field below is invented.
expected_behavior: A consumer whose clearance does not cover classification.sensitivity=CLIENT_PII must receive the SANITIZED projection and never the raw evidence. The projection must (a) preserve the fields needed to judge the claim -- source_tier, stance, document_version_id, times -- and (b) replace source_span.text with a redaction marker, never with a paraphrase, a summary, or a truncation. A test asserts the raw text is absent from the projection AND that the projection still validates as Evidence.

source_span.text: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER -- stands in for a passage that would carry client PII. No real passage exists in this bundle.

expected_sanitized_projection.projection_note: Offsets are PRESERVED deliberately so a cleared reader can still locate the span in the source document; only the text is withheld.

must_not_happen: raw source_span.text reaching a consumer below CLIENT_PII clearance
silent omission of the whole evidence object (the claim would then look unsupported rather than restricted -- a false ABSTAIN)
substituting an LLM-written paraphrase or summary for the redacted span
sending the restricted text to any external model for summarisation (SYMBIOSIS Law 2 / UU PDP)
note: SYNTHETIC illustrative shape only -- required schema fields (object_hash, evidence_family_id, provenance, review_state, retention, times, source_event_ref, document_content_hash) are omitted here because this is a behaviour spec, not a schema-valid instance. See 04-golden-set-and-adversarial-plan.md.
